name: mason-recap
description: Marketplace for mason-recap, an observability plugin that reconstructs how Claude Code handled a request from observed hook/transcript evidence.

plugins.name: mason-recap
plugins.description: Local, hooks-based observability for Claude Code: captures observable execution evidence (prompts, tool calls, file paths, subagent activity, final answer) into project-local JSONL logs, with sensitive-data masking, and provides /mason-recap:inspect-last, /mason-recap:inspect-session, and /mason-recap:status commands plus a decision-analysis Skill to reconstruct what Claude did and why — always separating observed facts from inferred interpretation and unknowns. No chain-of-thought extraction, no network calls, no external services.
